verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK that downloads models, so whether those files and caches can be reused by other runtimes is a fair question. The evidence covers download events and progress reporting but never says where model files live, what format they use, or whether other runtimes can reuse them without re-downloading or re-converting. The mention of a llama.cpp fallback is about the engine, not file reuse, so it does not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
